verses.english: Principles That Should Be Made Much Of

verses.pali: “Bahulīkātabbañca vo, bhikkhave, dhammaṁ desessāmi na bahulīkātabbañca.
verses.english: “I will teach you the principle to make much of and the principle not to make much of. …

verses.pali: katamo ca, bhikkhave, na bahulīkātabbo dhammo?
verses.english: And what is the principle not to make much of?

verses.pali: ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, na bahulīkātabbo dhammo.
verses.english: This is called the principle not to make much of.
And what is the principle to make much of?
This is called the principle to make much of.”
